data.name: Over_LOAD
data.detailed_description:
The robots have conquered everything in the future, and now they seek to invade the past. They expected little resistance, but the magic and ingenuity of the inhabitants of a remote castle have levelled the playing field. Play as a local knight, a courageous hunter, the forward-thinking blacksmith or the mysterious shaman to repel the tinskin menace for as long as you can!

This rougelike Vampire Survivors-type game has no ending, only how long your computer can last. Gain and upgrade your weapons, buy items from the shop to increase your abilities, and go for as long as you can. After each game, unlock new weapons and items and go all over again.

You don't need any other controls than Arrow Keys/WASD, E to Interact, and Spacebar to Dash. So you can play this game with just one hand!
